payload.reason: The evidence provides specific criteria used to determine the steady state of soil parameters, including the use of climate data and nitrogen deposition until the parameters reached a steady state, as well as referencing established methods from previous studies.

claims.text: The steady state of soil parameters was determined by using climate data and airborne nitrogen deposition until the parameters reached a steady state.
The steady-state conditions followed in the study are consistent with those established by Yang et al. (2005).
